test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 13 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined phrase in the given sentence.

Mani decided to __take a rain check__ on the dinner invitation.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "delay the decision".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"to take a rain check"** means to politely decline an offer or invitation for now but express willingness to accept it at a later time. (बाद में स्वीकार करना)

 
 
• **Example:** I can't join you for lunch today, but I'll take a rain check and catch up with you next week.
 
 
 
• **"Delay the decision"** refers to postponing or deferring an action, decision, or invitation to a later time. (निर्णय को स्थगित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Since I have a busy schedule tonight, I decided to delay the decision about attending the party.
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase "to take a rain check" aligns with the meaning of "delay the decision".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accept the offer** (प्रस्ताव स्वीकार करना): To agree to take or receive something offered.

 
 
• **Example:** She was delighted to accept the offer to join the new company.
 
 
 
• **Make the final decision** (अंतिम निर्णय लेना): To come to a definite conclusion or resolution about something.
 
 
• **Example:** After much deliberation, he made the final decision to move abroad.
 
 
 
• **To invite someone** (किसी को आमंत्रित करना): To request someone to join or attend an event or occasion.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to invite her friends to the dinner party at her home.
